records.jp: この先ずーっと海しかないって、<CR>いつ見てもすごいなぁ……
records.en_original: The water goes for as long as the eye can see... I can't help but be amazed every time I see it.
records.en: The water goes for as long as the eye can see... I can't help but be amazed every time I see it.

records.jp: 初めて見たときには、驚きました
records.en_original: I was very surprised the first time I saw it.
records.en: I was very surprised the first time I saw it.

records.jp: うん。私も<CR>見る度に、ちょっと不思議な気持ちになる
records.en_original: Yeah. Even now I still get a strange feeling every time I look out over the water.
records.en: Yeah. Even now I still get a strange feeling every time I look out over the water.

records.jp: 不思議な気持ち……<CR>どんな気持ちなんですか？
records.en_original: Strange, you say? What kind of feeling?
records.en: Strange, you say? What kind of feeling?

records.jp: ちょっと心細いような気持ち、かな
records.en_original: I think it's something like loneliness?
records.en: I think it's something like loneliness?

records.jp: この世界って、ホントに学校だけしか<CR>残ってないんだなー、みたいな？
records.en_original: It makes me think about how in this whole world, this school is the only thing that exists.
records.en: It makes me think about how in this whole world, this school is the only thing that exists.

records.jp: ココロトープもありますよ？
records.en_original: What about the Heartscapes?
records.en: What about the Heartscapes?

records.jp: そうなんだけどー！<CR>離れ小島に取り残されたみたいな？
records.en_original: Well, yeah, sure those are here too. But it feel like we've been abandoned on some desert island, doesn't it?
records.en: Well, yeah, sure those are here too. But it feel like we've been abandoned on some desert island, doesn't it?

records.jp: 食料も仲間も外敵もいますから、<CR>取り残されてはいないですよ？
records.en_original: We have plenty of food and friends with us, not to mention our enemies. I don't think it feels like we've been abandoned.
records.en: We have plenty of food and friends with us, not to mention our enemies. I don't think it feels like we've been abandoned.

records.jp: あ、それもそっか。<CR>……って、外敵はいらなかったよ！？
records.en_original: I guess that's true... Wait a sec, why did you include our enemies?!
records.en: I guess that's true... Wait a sec, why did you include our enemies?!

records.jp: んー。なんていうかなぁ……。<CR>どこか、ほっとするような……気持ち？
records.en_original: Hmm. How do I put this? I feel somehow...calm?
records.en: Hmm. How do I put this? I feel somehow...calm?

records.jp: 学校の周りが全部水なのに、<CR>ちょっと自分でも不思議なんだけどね
records.en_original: It's weird, isn't it? Looking out over all that water and feeling calm.
records.en: It's weird, isn't it? Looking out over all that water and feeling calm.

records.jp: ……実は私も少しだけ、ほっとした気持ちに<CR>なるんです
records.en_original: ...Actually, I think I feel something similar.
records.en: ...Actually, I think I feel something similar.

records.jp: え！　詩さんも？
records.en_original: Whoa, you too, Uta?
records.en: Whoa, you too, Uta-san?

records.jp: 星崎さんと同じ気持ちなのかは分かりませんが、<CR>心が凪いでいくのを感じます
records.en_original: I don't know if it's the same as the one you are feeling, but I do feel at peace here.
records.en: I don't know if I feel the same as you, Hoshizaki-san, but I can feel my heart growing calm.

records.jp: 囲まれてるんじゃなくて、包み込んでくれてる……。<CR>護られてるみたいな気持ちになるのかな……
records.en_original: I don't feel trapped, so much as...protected?
records.en: I don't feel trapped, so much as...protected?

records.jp: ……そうなのかも、しれませんね
records.en_original: You may be right.
records.en: You may be right.

records.jp: もし船があったら、星崎さんは水平線の向こうに<CR>行ってみたいと思いますか？
records.en_original: If we had a boat, do you think you'd like to sail out beyond the horizon?
records.en: If there were a boat, would you want to go beyond the horizon, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: 船かぁ……！<CR>考えたこともなかった！
records.en_original: A boat, huh? I never really thought about that!
records.en: A boat, huh? I never really thought about that!

records.jp: もしもこれが現実世界の海だったら……<CR>そんな仮定で考えてみてください
records.en_original: Imagine that this were the sea in the real world.
records.en: Imagine that this were the sea in the real world.

records.jp: 現実の海だったら、かぁ……
records.en_original: If this were the real sea...
records.en: If this were the real sea...

records.jp: そうだなぁ……<CR>詩さんと一緒なら行ってみたいかな
records.en_original: Let's see... I think I'd like to try it if you were with me.
records.en: Let me see... I think I'd like to go if you came with me, Uta-san.

records.jp: 私と一緒なら……ですか？
私平凡だからさ、詩さんの言葉で気付かされること、<CR>結構いっぱいあるんだよね
records.en_original: When I'm with you I learn so much. I think it's 'cause I'm so normal.
records.en: I'm ordinary, so there are quite a lot of things your words make me realize, Uta-san.

records.jp: だから一緒に大航海に出たら、<CR>ものすごい発見とかしちゃいそうだなぁって
records.en_original: That's why if I had you with me, I think you'd help me make a ton of new discoveries.
records.en: That's why if I had you with me, I think you'd help me make a ton of new discoveries.

records.jp: 私、足手まといになるかもしれませんよ？
records.en_original: I wouldn't be a burden?
records.en: I wouldn't be a burden?

records.jp: あはは。それ多分、私の役ー
records.en_original: Haha. I think I would be the only one being a burden.
records.en: Haha. I think I would be the only one being a burden.

records.jp: 星崎さんは……私たちの船長ですよ。<CR>私にとっては、きっと楽しい旅になると思います
records.en_original: I think you'd be our captain. I'm sure we'd have a wonderful journey with you leading us.
records.en: You are... our captain, Hoshizaki-san. For me, I'm sure it would be a fun journey.

records.jp: うーん。すっごい迷うけど……行かないかなぁ
records.en_original: Hmmm... It's hard to decide, but in the end, I don't think I would.
records.en: Hmmm... It's hard to decide, but in the end, I don't think I would.

records.jp: 前だったら「これぞファンタジー！」ってなったと<CR>思うんだけど、今はなんだかさ……
records.en_original: Up until recently I would have jumped at the chance for any kind of adventure, but now...
records.en: Up until recently I would have jumped at the chance for any kind of adventure, but now...

records.jp: 詩さんとこうやって、ぼーっと海を見てる方が<CR>いいなぁって思うんだよねー
records.en_original: I'd much rather sit with you, here, overlooking the sea.
records.en: I think I'd rather sit here spacing out and looking at the sea with you, Uta-san.

records.jp: ……星崎さんは、私の心が読めるんですか？
records.en_original: Are you a mind-reader, Ao?
records.en: Are you a mind-reader, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: へ？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: 私も、同じように思っていました
records.en_original: I was just thinking the same thing.
records.en: I was just thinking the same thing.

records.jp: 船出をすれば、何かを発見する可能性があっても……<CR>今はまだ、星崎さんと海を見ていたいと
records.en_original: We could make some wonderful discoveries journeying on the sea, but... I think for now, sitting here with you is enough.
records.en: Even if setting sail might lead to some discovery... for now, I still want to watch the sea with you, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: えへへ。おそろいだね！
records.en_original: Hehe. Two peas in a pod!
records.en: Hehe. Two peas in a pod!

records.jp: ……夏、だねぇ
records.en_original: ...Feels like summer.
records.en: ...Feels like summer.

records.jp: ……夏、ですね
records.en_original: ...Feels like summer.
records.en: ...Feels like summer.

records.jp: 考えたら、夏の海をふたり占めって、贅沢かも。<CR>詩さんは、海って好き？
records.en_original: Thinking about it, it's pretty sweet getting this whole beach all to ourselves. Do you like the beach, Uta?
records.en: Thinking about it, it's pretty sweet getting this whole beach all to ourselves. Do you like the beach, Uta-san?

records.jp: 私は……そうですね。<CR>嫌いではありません
records.en_original: I... I suppose I don't hate it.
records.en: I... I suppose I don't hate it.

records.jp: でも、夏の海は人が多いので、苦手です。<CR>誰もが泳ぎもしないのに、水着になって……
records.en_original: But in the summer there's too many people for me to enjoy it. And I don't know why everyone wears swimsuits, but no one swims.
records.en: But in the summer there's too many people for me to enjoy it. And I don't know why everyone wears swimsuits, but no one swims.

records.jp: たしかに、ガチで泳いでる人って<CR>そんないないよね……あ、そうだ！
records.en_original: I guess it's true that not a lot of people go to the beach just to swim... Oh, speaking of!
records.en: I guess it's true that not a lot of people go to the beach just to swim... Oh, speaking of!

records.jp: じゃあさ、約束しよっか
records.en_original: Hey, let's make a plan.
records.en: Hey, let's make a plan.

records.jp: いつか人があんまいない季節に、海行くの。<CR>で、ふたり占めして、とりあえずはしゃごーよ！
records.en_original: Let's go to the beach together in the off-season. Then we'll have the whole place to ourselves!
records.en: Let's go to the beach together in the off-season. Then we'll have the whole place to ourselves!

records.jp: ふふ。春や秋ならともかく……<CR>冬の海だとしたら、寒いかもしれませんよ？
records.en_original: Hehe. Maybe during spring or autumn... I'm sure the winter would be much to cold.
records.en: Hehe. Maybe during spring or autumn... I'm sure the winter would be much to cold.

records.jp: 冬だったら、それはそれ！
records.en_original: I bet we could even make winter work!
records.en: I bet we could even make winter work!

records.jp: ふたりであったかい缶ドリンク買ってくっついて、<CR>で、日が暮れるまで、浜辺でぼーっと海眺める！
records.en_original: We can buy hot canned drinks, huddle together on the beach, and just look out on the sea until sun sets!
records.en: We can buy hot canned drinks, huddle together on the beach, and just look out on the sea until sun sets!

records.jp: 冬なら夜空の星も、きっとよく見えますね
records.en_original: The stars would be very clear if it was winter.
records.en: The stars would be very clear if it was winter.

records.jp: あ、それもいいね！<CR>こーなったら、夜明かしコースで、星も見る！
records.en_original: Ooh, that sounds great! We could stay up all night stargazing!
records.en: Ooh, that sounds great! We could stay up all night stargazing!

records.jp: ……やりたいことが、増えていきますね。<CR>私、欲張りになったみたいです
records.en_original: So many things I want to do... It seems I've become quite spoiled.
records.en: So many things I want to do... It seems I've become quite spoiled.

records.jp: うん……私もだよ
records.en_original: Yeah... Me, too.
records.en: Yeah... Me, too.

records.jp: 詩さん。いいこと教えてあげる！
records.en_original: Uta. I'll let you in on a little something!
records.en: Uta-san. I'll let you in on a little something!

records.jp: いいこと……ですか？
records.en_original: What is it...?
records.en: What is it...?

records.jp: シーズンオフなら、海ってあんま人いないよ！<CR>それなら、海をふたり占めできる！
records.en_original: There aren't many people at the beach during the off-season. If we go then, we'll have the whole place all to ourselves!
records.en: There aren't many people at the beach during the off-season. If we go then, we'll have the whole place all to ourselves!

records.jp: ふたり占め、ですか？
records.en_original: The whole beach?
records.en: The whole beach?

records.jp: うん。現実世界の海を、私と詩さんでふたり占め！
records.en_original: Yeah. We'll rule over the whole beach! Just the two of us!
records.en: Yeah. The real-world ocean, all to ourselves—just Uta-san and me!

records.jp: シーズンオフというと……冬、あたりでしょうか？
records.en_original: The off-season... Does that mean the winter?
records.en: The off-season... Does that mean the winter?

records.jp: あ、いいねいいね！　雪なんか降ってたりすると、<CR>いい感じかも！　寒そうだけど
records.en_original: Winter would be perfect! Wouldn't it be great if it snowed? ...Though it does sound pretty cold.
records.en: Winter would be perfect! Wouldn't it be great if it snowed? ...Though it does sound pretty cold.

records.jp: では……約束、しませんか？<CR>きっとふたりで一緒に冬の海を見るって
records.en_original: Let's promise each other then. That'll we'll look over the ocean in the winter someday. Just the two of us.
records.en: Let's promise each other then. That'll we'll look over the ocean in the winter someday. Just the two of us.

records.jp: 詩さんから約束なんて、嬉しいな！<CR>うん！　いつか絶対、一緒に雪が降る海を見よう
records.en_original: A promise with Uta! How exciting! We'll make that happen. I know it.
records.en: A promise with Uta-san! How exciting! We'll make that happen. I know it.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
